functions.how: seven allocate-0x48 + FUN(obj, i) for i=0..6, each building a 101-point dB table (0x101aec640/arm 0x101ac2bf8) and gain table exp10f(dB*0.05) (0x101aec510/arm 0x101ac2ad8); dB ranges from the same int tables (x86 0x105dee880/898, arm 0x1058486a8/6c4)

60 points from max in 0.4 dB steps, 36 with an accelerating 0.04 dB step, 3-point landing, then min; snap |x|<1e-4 to 0; same mode switch. x86 computes the landing with separate mulss/addss; arm64 0x101ac30ec fuses fmadd s6,s0,3.0,s6 (one rounding)
writes gain[100-i] = exp10f(dB[i]*0.05); same 0.05 constant and reversal

functions.role: position -> gain (one curve object, slot +0x30 table)
functions.how: pos<=0 -> g[0]; pos>=1 -> g[100]; else k=floor(100*pos), frac snapped to 0/1 within 2^-17, linear interp in gain (double); same 100.0 and 2^-17 constants
0x65-step binary search over the 101-point table, inverse linear interp, 0 below g[0], 1 above g[100]; identical shape

functions.role: position -> gain by mode (global curve registry, engine path)
functions.how: same as 0x101aecbd0 but indexes the global curve registry (slot 10) by mode; identity when DAT flag set
same as 0x101aecc90 over the global registry by mode

inputs [w,pan,splitL,splitR,vol]; theta=x*pi/4+pi/4; L->L=vol(w cos thetaL + (1-w)max(1e-5, sqrt2 cos thetaP)); L->R=vol w sin thetaL; R->L=vol w cos thetaR; R->R=vol(w sin thetaR+(1-w)max(1e-5, sqrt2 sin thetaP)); vol=0 -> all 0. Same constants pi/4, pi/2, sqrt2, 1e-5

functions.role: crossfade table builder (fills a 129-point table from a curve function at i/64-1)
functions.how: loops i=0..128, arg = i*0.0078125*2 - 1 = i/64 - 1, table[i] = CrossfadeToLevel(arg); pointer table 0x106c9a4f0 holds the 7 curve function pointers in order

index = (crossfader*(1-state)+1)*64 into the 129-point table (byte table 1,1,1,1,1,1,0 selects multiply-gain vs multiply-position); gain <= 0.00032 -> 0. Reached the crossfade branch statically, not executed end to end
value != 0 -> "On", == 0 -> "Off"; x86 reads "On" at 0x10604fff4 and "Off" at 0x10604fff7; arm64 reads "On" at 0x105bafc64 and "Off" at 0x105af67ac (s9-mixer-v1 review check 2)
